sentences.text:
By this petition, petitioners are seeking direction upon respondents not to proceed further with the construction/execution of PMGSY road namely "L021-(Link Road) Chattibanday to Bodinar"
(3.500 Kms) over and through the propriety/private land of the petitioners, falling under Survey Nos. 1799 & 1800 including shamilat Deh land, till the land is lawfully acquired and the compensation is determined and paid in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 2. Mr. Waseem Gul, learned counsel for the respondents has produced communication dated 02.02.2026, wherein it is stated that the execution of the project has been undertaken in phased manner, ensuring that no propriety land would be disturbed without consent and the machinery movement has been confined to the demarcated track only.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The same is taken on record.
3. Notice waived by Mr. Waseem Gul, learned counsel for the respondents.
He seeks and is granted four weeks' time to file reply with an advance copy to the other side.
4. Mr. Waseem Gul, learned counsel for the respondents is directed to seek and instructions on the next date of hearing.
